reason: An AI image-generation workbench for text-to-image and image-to-image creation, with configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoints, image history, gallery management, and prompt templates.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 的图像接口提供文生图、图生图编辑、历史记录、画廊收藏和提示词模板管理。
summaries.en: Provides text-to-image and image-to-image generation through OpenAI-compatible APIs, with history, gallery management, and prompt templates.

capabilities: Generates images from text through OpenAI-compatible image APIs
Edits images using uploaded PNG, JPG, or WEBP references
Sends configured API requests through the host process
Stores generated images, history, gallery data, and cached template images on the host
Fetches prompt-template images and checks GitHub Releases for updates
